content: Batteries nightly-testing will now receive automated PRs with adaptations from downstream-lean4, the first of which can be found at batteries#1956. If the PR becomes too outdated to merge, just close it and a new one will be opened again soon.
Cslib has already been receiving PRs like this for the last few weeks, though I suspect batteries will receive them more frequently.
Whenever a new PR like this is opened (and assuming CI doesn't break), a bot will post a message in this thread.
PR batteries#1957 with downstream-lean4 adaptations for nightly-2026-09-02 has just been opened. Please review the changes. No new adaptation PRs will be opened while this PR is still open.

Note that these PRs should only be reviewed as rigorously as any other contributions to nightly-testing. Once they are merged, they still have to go through the bump/v*-based review process like any other nightly-testing change.
PR batteries#1958 with downstream-lean4 adaptations for nightly-2026-09-06 has just been opened. Please review the changes. No new adaptation PRs will be opened while this PR is still open.

Now, these kinds of adaptations should be pushed from downstream-lean4 directly to the batteries nightly branch instead of having to go through an intermediary PR like before. This setup is similar to how things worked before downstream-lean4 when lean devs would push their changes directly to the nightly branch as well.
